method: Authority year ledgers are evidence indexes. Listed years may have detailed authority notes available, but year inclusion is not converted into a score. Omitted years are not automatically bad; they may simply lack an archive entry for this product family.

archives.productFamily: Vintage Port and historically documented Vintage/Single-Quinta declarations
archives.historicalIdentityNote: The archive spans legal and commercial regimes predating current DOP terminology. Use the modern Porto/Douro reference for geography while storing the historical designation/regulatory regime separately.
archives.declarationNote: An archive year does not mean every Port shipper declared a Vintage. The authority notes explicitly distinguish general declarations, split vintages, off-vintages and Single Quinta declarations in some years.

archives.historicalIdentityNote: The MATU network has operated since 1956, but this record does not assert that each annual commune/grape dataset has been ingested. Individual years remain pending until the underlying annual records are captured.
